newsitem.title: USA: Iowa-S Minn cattle off $0.50 at $69.50 - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Iowa-S Minn cattle off $0.50 at $69.50 - USDA.

text.p: Slaughter steers and heifers were steady to $0.50 lower, compared with Wednesday's close, USDA said. Trade was slow to moderate, demand moderate and seller interest light to moderate. Offerings light.
Steers - Select to mostly Choice 2-4 1150-1300 lbs 69.00-69.50.
Heifers - Select to mostly Choice 2-4 1050-1200 lbs 69.00-69.50.
On a carcass basis (weight only), compared with Wednesday's close, slaughter steers and heifers were weak.

Steers - Select to mostly Choice 2-4 1150-1300 lbs 109.00-110.00 many 109.00. Holstein - (weight only) Select to mostly Choice 2-3 1250-1400 lbs 102.00-103.00. Holstein - (grade and weight) Choice 2-3 1250-1400 lbs 1250-1400 lbs 104.00 Select 2-3 1250-1400 lbs 1250-1400 lbs 98.00.
Heifers - Select to mostly Choice 2-4 1050-1200 lbs 109.00-110.00 many 109.00.
